turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My goal this year is one single pull-up. I can't do even half of one.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great goal. Start with dead hangs, just hanging from the bar for as long as you can.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It builds grip and shoulder strength. Then add negatives, jump up to the top and lower yourself as slowly as you can.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, Our hallway is a shoe disaster and I'm picking some kind of storage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A simple open rack by the door, fits about twelve pairs, very cheap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bench with closed cupboards underneath, so you can sit to put boots on and hide the mess.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An over the door organiser with pockets, which takes up no floor at all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a rule that shoes go back in each person's bedroom, no storage needed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it, that's the lot. Your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The bench is the nicest long-term, it hides everything and gives you a seat. The open rack is cheap but still looks cluttered, the door pockets suit small flats, and the bedroom rule only works if everyone obeys it.
